thread:
Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — I'm onboarding llama-3-small weights to staging. Weights are at s3://redwood-models/llama3/small/v1/. Tokenizer JSON from modelhub looks slightly off (special_tokens missing and pad_token_id null). Can folks sanity-check serving config (batching / cache / scheduler / max_tokens) for low-latency chat usage? Also need a quick tokenizer roundtrip test.

Jamal Rivera: Got it. Which exact tokenizer file are you using? I can run the roundtrip script against staging-serving.

Maya Patel: tokenizer at s3://redwood-models/llama3/small/v1/tokenizer.json. Serving config I'm using is copy of llama3-medium prod route but with lower mem limits. Want suggestions to keep latency ~<100ms for 16-64 token prompts.

Ronit Sharma: quick note — I saw tokenizer.json missing "special_tokens_map" for BOS/EOS in a recent modelhub push. If tokenizer returns pad_token_id=null the tokenizer can produce different token ids than embedding table expects. Do: tokenizer.encode("Hello") and compare max(id) < embedding_size. Also watch for attention_mask dtype (we expect int64).

Kevin Lu: For interactive short prompts I usually do: lower batch_timeout_ms (10-25ms), moderate max_batch_size (8-32), and set max_batch_tokens so very long prompt don't blow up batch packing. Enable prefix KV cache for repeated turns with TTL 300-600s. Example config we can try in staging:

```
serving:
  batching:
    max_batch_size: 32
    max_batch_tokens: 2048
    batch_timeout_ms: 20
  cache:
    kv_cache_enabled: true
    prefix_cache_ttl_sec: 600
    entry_max_tokens: 1024
  scheduler:
    strategy: fair_share
    max_concurrent_infers: 8
    preemptive_slots: 2
  max_output_tokens: 512
```

Sasha Kim: note: max_output_tokens must be enforced per-route and ensure model_context - prompt_tokens >= max_output_tokens. Otherwise we get forced truncation. Also add a per-route override for microburst traffic.

Jamal Rivera: running roundtrip now against staging-serving host rtd-stg-01. Will post tokenizer.encode("Hello world") and vocab size.

Maya Patel: thanks. Also can someone validate that the quantized weight path is correct in the config? My staging YAML points to s3://redwood-models/llama3/small/v1/quantized/ggml-q4_0.bin — that matches what model conversion outputted but worth double-checking.

Ronit Sharma: quick log from my local check (snippet):

```
[INFO] loading tokenizer from s3://.../tokenizer.json
[INFO] vocab_size=32000
[WARN] model embedding matrix shape=(31992, 4096)
[ERROR] pad_token_id=null -> token ids may be shifted by +1
```

Looks like vocab vs embedding mismatch (32k vs 31,992). Two quick fixes: regenerate tokenizer bundled with model, or call tokenizer.add_tokens([...]) then resize embeddings in the conversion pipeline. For staging tests resizing is fine, but for prod prefer regenerating tokenizer to match embedding.

Kevin Lu: I agree — don't resize embeddings in prod unless you know the training step. For staging can do resize_embeddings to unblock. Also tweak scheduler weights: give interactive routes higher priority via fair_share weights so background batch jobs don't starve them.

deploy-bot: automated-checks: serving-config-lint v2.1 -> WARN: batch_timeout_ms (20ms) is low for max_batch_tokens=2048; consider lowering max_batch_tokens or increase batch_timeout for long prompts. tokenizer-roundtrip -> RUNNING

Jamal Rivera: tokenizer.encode("Hello world") -> [154, 22, 198, 2] ; vocab_size 32000. Roundtrip lossless for ascii but I can also run encode/decode loop across 1k random samples and post results.

Maya Patel: perfect. Once Ronit confirms whether we should resize embeddings I'll update conversion pipeline. After fixes let's do a 5% canary for 24h on staging route rtd-canary-llama3-small. @Jamal can you kick the canary after the fixes? :thumbsup:

Ronit Sharma: I'll push a quick patch to conversion that adds missing special_tokens_map and pads tokenizer to vocab_size then re-run conversion. Expect to have artifacts in s3 in ~30m.

Kevin Lu: when you re-run, please also include a lite perf test: 1000 requests with prompt length 16, measure p50/p95 latency, and tokens/sec. Post results to this thread. If p95 > 250ms we'll iterate on batch_timeout and max_concurrent_infers.

Maya Patel: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll wait for the new artifacts and then schedule the canary.
